title: PAINT issue:FBgn0035942 ValRS-m

author: marcfeuermann
body: I removed the annotation from the cytosol for FBgn0035942 ValRS-m. Since the cytosolic and mitochondrial sequences appear to alternate in the tree, I cannot extend the annotation to the mitochondria. The only solution would be to extend both to that region and alternately block one or the other, which would be undesirable. Here, the primary annotations are essential.
